title: KLIA2 Arrival Hall: From the Gate to Your Ride
metaDescription: Land at KLIA2 and follow the route from your gate to immigration, bags, your SIM and the bus, train, taxi or Grab. Which floor each ride leaves from.

contentBlocks.content: The KLIA2 arrival hall is on Level 2 of the main terminal. You reach it after immigration, baggage reclaim and customs, then leave by Door B into the Gateway@klia2 mall. From there, taxis are on the same floor, the bus and train platforms are one floor down on Level 1, and Grab picks up on the LG floor below that. Book your ride before you board and the only thing left to do on landing is walk.
Key Takeaways
Which floor is the KLIA2 arrival hall on? Level 2. You come out of customs onto Level 2 and leave the hall by Door B.
Where do taxis leave from? Level 2, the same floor. The taxi counters are by Door 2 and outside Door 3, next to the taxi queue.
Where are the bus and the train? The bus leaves from the Transportation Hub on Level 1. Train tickets are sold on Level 2 of Gateway@klia2 and the platforms are on Level 1.
Where is Grab pickup? In the Transportation Hub on the LG floor. Follow the e-hailing signs down past Level 1.
Before you land

Three things are easier done before you fly. Fill in your Malaysia Digital Arrival Card; our MDAC guide walks through every field. Book your ride from KLIA2, so you know where you are going when you reach the hall. And check that your phone will have data when you land, because bus e-tickets and Grab both need it. Sort all three before you board.
From your gate to the arrival hall

Domestic flights park close to the main terminal. If your international flight parks at the satellite building, you cross the Skybridge, a long covered walkway with travelators, to reach the main terminal. Either way, you follow the Arrival signs down to Level 2. It is a long walk on a busy evening. Keep your passport and your MDAC confirmation in your hand as you go.
Immigration, bags and customs

The order is always the same: immigration first, then baggage reclaim, then customs. Screens in the baggage hall show which belt has your flight. If you are eligible for the autogates, the MDAC guide explains who can use them. Once you are through customs, look for the pillar marked with a large B and walk out by Door B.
Out through Door B: where each ride leaves from
Every ride out of KLIA2 starts from the same spot. Walk straight out of Door B into the Gateway@klia2 mall, past the shops, until you reach FamilyMart. From there:

RideFloorHow to find it
Taxi from the counterLevel 2The ttklia.com counter is on your right by Door 2, just after FamilyMart. A second kiosk and the taxi queue are outside Door 3.
Booked taxiLevel 2Your driver waits in the arrival hall with a name board. No walk needed.
BusLevel 1Turn left at FamilyMart and take the travelator down to the Transportation Hub. The bus counter and kiosks are ahead of you.
KLIA Ekspres or KLIA TransitTickets Level 2, platforms Level 1Buy at the counters or machines on Level 2 of Gateway@klia2, then go down one level to the platforms.
GrabLGFollow the e-hailing signs to the Transportation Hub, then one floor below Level 1.

If you get lost, look up. Every direction board in KLIA2 lists the floors, and the door numbers are printed above each exit as Pintu (Door). Our KLIA2 bus station guide and KLIA2 taxi counter guide show both walks on video. Watch the one you need before you land.

content.heading: See every bus from KLIA2
content.subheading: Buses leave the Transportation Hub on Level 1 for KL Sentral, Pudu Sentral, Lalaport BBCC, TBS and towns across Malaysia. Pick yours before you land.

contentBlocks.content: Collect your SIM on the way

If you booked a Teeko travel SIM, collect it at the tour centre in KLIA2 before you head for your ride; the exact counter details come with your booking. Not sure whether a SIM or an eSIM suits you? Read our guide to tourist SIM cards in Malaysia and book before you fly.
Which ride suits you

• Staying near KL Sentral. The KLIA2 to KL Sentral guide compares the bus, the train, taxi and Grab on time and fare.
  • Staying in Bukit Bintang. Read the KLIA2 to Bukit Bintang guide, or take the bus to the Lalaport transport hub, one stop from Bukit Bintang.
  • Travelling as a family or with heavy bags. A taxi booked for the whole group is often simpler. Our Kuala Lumpur airport transfer guide sets out the choices.
  • Heading out of the city. Buses from KLIA2 also go to Melaka, Ipoh, Penang, Johor Bahru and Singapore.
Pick your ride from that list, then book it before you fly.
Landing late or changing terminals

Landing near midnight? The last trains leave KLIA2 between midnight and about 1 AM, so read staying at KLIA2 or riding now before you choose. Flying on from KLIA Terminal 1? KLIA2 is a separate terminal; our KLIA1 to KLIA2 guide shows the train, the shuttle bus and the taxi. Check your onward terminal on your ticket today.
Frequently Asked Questions
Which floor is the arrival hall at KLIA2?
The arrival hall at KLIA2 is on Level 2 of the main terminal. You leave it by Door B into the Gateway@klia2 mall, where the taxi counters are on the same floor.
Where is the pick up point at KLIA2 arrival?

The pick up point at KLIA2 arrival depends on your ride. Taxis leave from outside Door 3 on Level 2, buses from the Transportation Hub on Level 1, and Grab from the LG floor. A booked taxi driver meets you in the arrival hall.
Is KLIA2 the same as KLIA?
No, KLIA2 is not the same terminal as KLIA. They are separate buildings about 2 km apart, linked by the KLIA Transit train and a shuttle bus. Check which one your flight uses.
Where do I buy train tickets at KLIA2?

You buy KLIA Ekspres and KLIA Transit tickets at the counters or machines on Level 2 of Gateway@klia2, or online before you fly. The counters close at 11 PM. The platforms are one floor down on Level 1.
Conclusion

From the KLIA2 arrival hall, every ride starts at Door B. Taxis are on Level 2, the bus and train platforms on Level 1, and Grab on the LG floor. Fill in your MDAC, sort your SIM, then pick your bus from KLIA2 on ttklia.com before you fly.
